54: 	/**
55: 	 * Returns the orientation obtained from the Exif metadata.
56: 	 * 
57: 	 * @param reader		An {@link ImageReader} which is reading the
58: 	 * 						target image.
59: 	 * @param imageIndex	The index of the image from which the Exif
60: 	 * 						metadata should be read from.
61: 	 * @return				The orientation information obtained from the
62: 	 * 						Exif metadata, as a {@link Orientation} enum.
63: 	 * 						Returns {@code null} if no orientation is found.
64: 	 * @throws IOException				When an error occurs during reading.
65: 	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException	If the {@link ImageReader} does not
66: 	 * 									have the target image set, or if the
67: 	 * 									reader does not have a JPEG open.
68: 	 */
69: 	public static Orientation getExifOrientation(ImageReader reader, int imageIndex) throws IOException {
70: 		IIOMetadata metadata = reader.getImageMetadata(imageIndex);
71: 		Node rootNode = metadata.getAsTree("javax_imageio_jpeg_image_1.0");
72: 
73: 		NodeList childNodes = rootNode.getChildNodes();
74: 
75: 		// Look for the APP1 containing Exif data, and retrieve it.
76: 		for (int i = 0; i < childNodes.getLength(); i++) {
77: 			if ("markerSequence".equals(childNodes.item(i).getNodeName())) {
78: 				NodeList markerSequenceChildren = childNodes.item(i).getChildNodes();
79: 
80: 				for (int j = 0; j < markerSequenceChildren.getLength(); j++) {
81: 					IIOMetadataNode metadataNode = (IIOMetadataNode) (markerSequenceChildren.item(j));
82: 
83: 					byte[] bytes = (byte[]) metadataNode.getUserObject();
84: 					if (bytes == null) {
85: 						continue;
86: 					}
87: 
88: 					byte[] magicNumber = new byte[4];
89: 					ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).get(magicNumber);
90: 
91: 					if (EXIF_MAGIC_STRING.equals(new String(magicNumber))) {
92: 						return getOrientationFromExif(bytes);
93: 					}
94: 				}
95: 			}
96: 		}
97: 
98: 		return null;
99: 	}
100: 
101: 	/**
102: 	 * Returns the orientation obtained from the Exif metadata.
103: 	 *
104: 	 * @param exifData		A byte array containing Exif data.
105: 	 * @return				The orientation information obtained from the
106: 	 * 						Exif metadata, as a {@link Orientation} enum.
107: 	 * 						Returns {@code null} if no orientation is found.
108: 	 */
109: 	public static Orientation getOrientationFromExif(byte[] exifData) {
110: 		// Needed to make byte-wise reading easier.
111: 		ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(exifData);
112: 
113: 		byte[] exifId = new byte[4];
114: 		buffer.get(exifId);
115: 
116: 		if (!EXIF_MAGIC_STRING.equals(new String(exifId))) {
117: 			return null;
118: 		}
119: 
120: 		// read the \0 after the Exif
121: 		buffer.get();
122: 		// read the padding byte
123: 		buffer.get();
124: 
125: 		byte[] tiffHeader = new byte[8];
126: 		buffer.get(tiffHeader);
127: 
128: 		/*
129: 		 * The first 2 bytes of the TIFF header contains either:
130: 		 *   "II" for Intel byte alignment (little endian), or
131: 		 *   "MM" for Motorola byte alignment (big endian)
132: 		 */
133: 		ByteOrder bo;
134: 		if (tiffHeader[0] == 'I' && tiffHeader[1] == 'I') {
135: 			bo = ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN;
136: 		} else {
137: 			bo = ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		byte[] numFields = new byte[2];
141: 		buffer.get(numFields);
142: 
143: 		int nFields = ByteBuffer.wrap(numFields).order(bo).getShort();
144: 
145: 		byte[] ifd = new byte[12];
146: 		for (int i = 0; i < nFields; i++) {
147: 			buffer.get(ifd);
148: 			IfdStructure ifdStructure = readIFD(ifd, bo);
149: 
150: 			// Return the orientation from the orientation IFD
151: 			if (ifdStructure.getTag() == 0x0112) {
152: 				return Orientation.typeOf(ifdStructure.getOffsetValue());
153: 			}
154: 		}
155: 
156: 		return null;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	private static IfdStructure readIFD(byte[] ifd, ByteOrder bo) {
160: 		ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(ifd).order(bo);
161: 
162: 		short tag = buffer.getShort();
163: 		short type = buffer.getShort();
164: 		int count = buffer.getInt();
165: 
166: 		IfdType ifdType = IfdType.typeOf(type);
167: 		int offsetValue = 0;
168: 		
169: 		/*
170: 		 * Per section 4.6.2 of the Exif Spec, if value is smaller than
171: 		 * 4 bytes, it will exist in the earlier byte.
172: 		 */
173: 		int byteSize = count * ifdType.size();
174: 
175: 		if (byteSize <= 4) {
176: 			if (ifdType == IfdType.SHORT) {
177: 				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
178: 					offsetValue = buffer.getShort();
179: 				}
180: 			} else if (ifdType == IfdType.BYTE || ifdType == IfdType.ASCII || ifdType == IfdType.UNDEFINED) {
181: 				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
182: 					offsetValue = buffer.get();
183: 				}
184: 			} else {
185: 				offsetValue = buffer.getInt();
186: 			}
187: 		} else {
188: 			offsetValue = buffer.getInt();
189: 		}
190: 		
191: 		return new IfdStructure(tag, type, count, offsetValue);
192: 	}
193: }
